product.description: Stage Right™ by Monoprice™15‑Watt 1x12 Guitar Combo Tube Amp with Celestion Speaker and Spring ReverbWorld's best reviewed and most affordable 15‑watt 1x12 all‑tube guitar ampThe Monoprice™ Stage Right™ 15‑Watt 1x12 Guitar Combo Tube Amp has gained fame and incredible praise for combining superior tone and unparalleled affordability. With its dual EL84 and triple 12AX7 tube design, the Stage Right 15W Guitar Combo Tube Amp delivers the tone and features of guitar amps costing several times its price. It includes a genuine spring reverb, 3‑band EQ section, 1‑watt mode and switch, and a Celestion® Seventy 80 12" speaker. Simply put, the Stage Right 15‑Watt 1x12 Guitar Combo Tube Amp is the best‑reviewed and most affordable all‑tube guitar combo amp in the world, for good reason.All‑tube design, driven by two EL84 and three 12AX7 tubesFeatures a Celestion® Seventy 80 12" speaker1‑watt mode for quiet playing without compromising toneGenuine spring reverb with foot switch control3‑band EQ sectionFX loop and external cabinet output REVIEWERS' TOP CHOICESince its launch, the Monoprice™ Stage Right™ 15‑Watt 1x12 Guitar Combo Tube Amp made an impact in the guitar community, earning exceptional reviews from credible players all over the world. Described as "mind blowingly good", "best bang for buck", or simply "amazing", players continue to validate the amp's claims of tone and affordability. Check the reviews for yourself, and see why we call the Stage Right™ 15‑Watt 1x12 Guitar Combo Tube Amp the best‑reviewed and most affordable guitar tube amp in the world. ALL‑TUBE DESIGNLike proven and iconic guitar tube amps of the past, the Monoprice™ Stage Right™ 15‑Watt 1x12 Guitar Combo Tube Amp uses a pair of EL84 tubes to drive its 15 watts of output power. Known for their "tight and chimey" sound, EL84s are responsible for producing countless iconic guitar tones, from clean to overdriven and everything in between. In addition to its power tubes, the Stage Right 15‑Watt 1x12 Guitar Combo Tube Amp features three 12AX7 preamp tubes to drive its front end. QUIET PLAYING. NO COMPROMISE IN TONE.Fifteen watts of all‑tube driven sound is louder than most people think. This is why the Monoprice™ Stage Right 15‑Watt 1x12 Guitar Combo Tube Amp features a 1‑watt mode and switch that cuts the amp's output without changing its tone. The 1‑watt mode gives you the flexibility to have a true practice amp, while driving the front and back end of the amp for rich, overdriven tones. REAL SPRING REVERBUnlike lower quality equally‑priced guitar tube amps, the Monoprice™ Stage Right™ 15‑Watt 1x12 Guitar Combo Tube Amp features a genuine spring reverb. Superior to both plate or digital reverbs when used for guitars, spring reverbs are typically found in vintage or boutique amps costing orders of magnitude more. CELESTION LOADEDAnother reason for its exceptional value is that the Monoprice™ Stage Right™ 15‑Watt 1x12 Guitar Combo Tube Amp features a genuine Celestion® Seventy 80 12" guitar speaker. The Seventy 80 is one of Celestion's most popular guitar speakers for its balance and adaptability.
